current_claim: A local-first FAB operating desk carrying one bounded administrative case through records, decisions, evidence, contained functions, effect firewall, and portable handoff.
mechanism: A single-file local runtime combines public-safe case objects, local source hashing, draft dispositions, contained role checks, external-effect refusal, and exportable state.

findings.title: The public cartridge reconstructs a real administrative aftermath without a complete immutable source registry in the release.
findings.mechanism: Source summaries and local hashing preserve a boundary, but the seven objects, five decisions, actor aliases, force states, and accepted offers are not all bound to source identities and extraction receipts visible to a successor.
findings.acceptance: Every object, force transition, decision dependency, and actor alias resolves to a source receipt or an explicit unresolved state.

findings.title: The seven contained seats are not yet proven as materially different operating apertures.
findings.mechanism: A role check can pass while each seat receives the same data, same next step, same authority, and same export under different labels.
findings.acceptance: Playtest every seat against the same case and verify distinct evidence needs, lawful actions, refusal conditions, and handoff outputs.

findings.title: The qualification is a boolean feature inventory rather than a retained perceptual and operational evidence package.
findings.mechanism: Flags such as responsive_floor, motion_polish, embedded_house_fonts, and case_ledger_flavor can be true while kerning, hierarchy, compact-width behavior, help, or interaction semantics regress.
findings.acceptance: Add visual goldens, typography metrics, keyboard and touch traces, corrupted-import and storage-loss cases, separate-browser successor replay, and export rehydration receipts.

next_gate: Reconstruct the cartridge from source receipts, then replay it from every seat.
